identity_cost.detail: A card and a phone number, because a hosted agent bills through an Azure subscription. Azure's signup FAQ: 'All you need is a phone number, a credit card or a debit card (non-prepaid), and a Microsoft account or a GitHub account.' A second gate on the card: 'Only credit cards are accepted in Hong Kong and Brazil.' The account itself is a Microsoft or GitHub one: 'You can sign up with either a Microsoft account or a GitHub account.' Country limit, quoted: 'Azure free account, free services, and $200 credit don’t include sovereign cloud products in US Government, Azure China, and Azure Germany regions.'
